areas.name: North Rhine-Westphalia (residential land values, all committees)

attribution: Obere Gutachterausschuss NRW / Land Nordrhein-Westfalen (BORIS.NRW), Bodenrichtwerte NRW, open geodata (Datenlizenz Deutschland - Zero - Version 2.0). Matched-zone yearly chain of residential land values, built by us.
basis: LAND VALUES, not dwelling prices: geometric-mean change of the committee's Bodenrichtwert (EUR/m2 of residential building land) over the zones valued in both of two consecutive years, chained, annual (1 January)
name: Siegen
notes: Siegen: LAND VALUES, not dwelling prices. Yearly chain of the Gutachterausschuss's Bodenrichtwerte (official standard values of ready-to-build residential land, EUR/m2), 1 January of each year, 2011 to 2026; each step is the geometric-mean change of the residential zones valued in both years (81 to 108 zones). Annual points; the quarters between are interpolated by the builder. Land values are set from the previous year's sales of unbuilt plots (and of built plots by residual methods), move in steps and more slowly than flat prices, and leave out building costs: read this as the land component of house prices. North Rhine-Westphalia (all committees, same method) is shown for comparison; mixed-use land is a segment where long enough; 0 Stadtteile with at least 5 matched zones in every step are districts. A committee that re-numbers or re-draws its zones breaks the chain (it then starts after the break); a committee-wide re-calibration moves the mean in that year.
